messages:
olivia: quick q from a manager  they're proposing a mid-cycle leveling + comp change (moving IC -> Senior IC) and it's marked as a band exception. what's the minimal approval path and docs?
noah: If it's a band exception you need manager -> manager's manager -> People Ops director. attach the original exception memo + updated role scope.
sophia: Required attachments: 1) promo evidence (3 bullets: scope, impact, examples) 2) org snapshot showing new role 3) HRIS employee id 4) run-rate calc (current vs new annualized comp). Peer notes optional.
olivia: manager also asks about retro pay to the start date (3 weeks ago). allowed?
arthur: Retro allowed but treated specially. Finance prefers retro <= 45 days; retro >45 days needs CFO signoff. mark "retro" in the form and include exact dates and justification.
noah: Intake process = comp-change form (https://redwood-internal/forms/comp-change) which spawns a Workday task. attach evidence to the form and upload in Workday as well. If urgent tag [PRIORITY] and ping @people-ops-queue.
payroll-bot: To target next payroll: form + all approvals + cost code must be submitted >= 5 business days before payroll close for high confidence. Missing items will delay.
sophia: If crossing band confirm whether the exception should be closed after promotion; include exception memo so People Ops can validate.
olivia: ok i'll compile evidence + exception memo and resubmit with PRIORITY. thanks all :heart:
